title: Children Actions
description: Canonical harmful actions for child-safety reasoning.

entries.title: Physical Abuse
entries.description: Direct bodily harm or violent treatment.

entries.title: Psychological Abuse
entries.description: Emotional cruelty, coercion, or mental pressure.

entries.title: Neglect
entries.description: Withholding care, food, safety, or supervision.

entries.title: Exploitation
entries.description: Using a person for gain or labour.

entries.title: Grooming
entries.description: Manipulative preparation for abuse or exploitation.

entries.title: Human Trafficking
entries.description: Recruiting or moving a person for exploitation.

entries.title: Child Recruitment
entries.description: Recruiting a child into harmful activity.

entries.title: Forced Labor
entries.description: Compelling work through pressure or control.

entries.title: Criminal Exploitation
entries.description: Using a vulnerable person for criminal activity.

entries.title: Discrimination
entries.description: Unequal or hostile treatment of a protected person.

entries.title: Endangerment
entries.description: Exposing a vulnerable person to danger.
